actions: car gradually sinks lower into the water across 18.0 to 18.8 s, wheels progressively submerged
text: Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
observed: Frames 18.0 to 18.8 s. The side view of the flooded street. The white car's wheels and lower body gradually go under the brown water so that by the last frame only the upper body shows with reflection. Background houses, tree and signs are static. Caption unchanged. The bottom third is empty pavement.
